description: This file implements Wi-Fi HAL version 3 functions for Raspberry Pi, including radio capabilities, security settings, WPS configuration, and VAP management.

methods.name: rpi_get_radios
methods.description: Returns the number of radios supported (hardcoded to 2).

methods.name: rpi_map_str2enum_fromTable
methods.description: Maps a string to an enum value based on a lookup table.

methods.name: rpi_str2uintArray
methods.description: Converts a delimited string of numbers into an array of unsigned ints.

methods.name: wifi_updateApSecurity
methods.description: Updates security settings for a specified access point.

methods.name: wifi_setApSecurity
methods.description: Sets security configuration for a specified access point.

methods.name: wifi_setApWpsConfiguration
methods.description: Configures WPS settings for a specified access point.

methods.name: wifi_createVAP
methods.description: Creates and configures Virtual Access Points based on provided map.

methods.name: rpi_getRadioCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities of a specified radio, including band, supported rates, and security modes.

methods.name: wifi_getHalCapability
methods.description: Retrieves overall Wi-Fi HAL capabilities including radios and features.

methods.name: wifi_getApSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves security settings for a specific access point.

methods.name: wifi_getRadioVapInfoMap
methods.description: Retrieves information about VAPs for a given radio index.

methods.name: wifi_getRadioOperatingParameters
methods.description: Gets current operating parameters of a radio, including channel, bandwidth, and rates.

methods.name: wifi_setRadioOperatingParameters
methods.description: Sets operating parameters for a radio, including channel, bandwidth, and rates.
